<p>Bäverbutiken började inte som en buti:
Beaver Store (Bäverbutiken in Swedish) didn't start out as a store. It started in a garage, with cables that needed connecting, cable lugs that were missing and a pair of pliers that didn't work. The solution was a small quick connector that you simply push on. We named it the Beaver Connector, after Sweden's hardest-working builder.

Then came the Beaver Lamp, for anyone who tinkers when it's dark. And the Beaver Funnel, which stays put on the can when you refuel the lawn mower. Every time it was the same thing: an everyday item that ought to exist, but that nobody had made properly.

Today Beaver Store is a full store with over 200 products for the garage, the boat, the garden and camping. Think of that hardware store you like to wander around in, but online and with only the things that are actually worth having. Everything we bring in has to prove itself first. Whatever doesn't measure up gets cut.
